2022: Russia's register misses occupied-territory militias before annexation in October 2022, so the true ratio is likely lower.
2023: The widest gap of the war: 5 wounded per death, above the historical 2.5–4. Some 2023 deaths may sit in 2025's count after late court declarations.
2024: Inside the historical range. Mediazona and Meduza's probate estimate (about 93,000) agrees with the leak.
2025: Courts declared tens of thousands of soldiers missing since 2022–24 dead during 2025 (Meduza), inflating this year's register. Pooled with 2024 the ratio is 2.9×.
2026: 3.0× once registration lag is corrected. The record months of September to November are not yet in the leak.
